policy: Allowlisted source distribution only; original working sources and excluded local data are preserved outside this publication checkout.
explicit_boundaries: No customer or real-site materials, including SAD RASTSVET.
No private FH-87 mesh/BREP/identity-map assets or scene loader. Generic decoder source remains.
No historical acceptance certificates, machine profiles, screenshots or compiled binaries.
No private SDK vendor or font/resource redistribution. SDK is fetched separately at a pinned public revision.
Checked Windows UIA and raw live GPU diagnostic integrations are explicitly unsupported in the public SDK build; no legacy or CPU qualification fallback.
included_test_source: Small first-party synthetic regression inputs and independent numerical references, plus test-only recipes that generate large report fixtures outside the checkout.
